system.description: The blazing elemental fury of the Dragon-Blooded is such that lesser men are humbled by their mere presence. When this Charm is activated, the Dragon-Blood is surrounded by a nimbus of Essence with the color associated with her aspect. Anyone attempting to look at the Dragon-Blood or to make a melee attack against her must score at least one success on a reflexive Willpower check. Even if that roll is successful, any attack made on the Dragon-Blooded before his next action suffers a dice penalty equal to the DragonBlood's Presence. This effect lasts until the Dragon-Blood's next action. The Charm affects only those individuals within yards a number of yards equal to the Dragon-Blood's Essence, and it doesn't impair ranged attacks.
